summary: One church. Weekend, weekday, confession and daily Adoration Chapel times agree in both November issues and on the website, which places the chapel on the rectory porch facing the church. Christmas and Jan 1 Masses come from the parish's current Seasonal Mass Times page. Open: the Dec 15 penance service and whether the box's generic Holy Days line adds 12 PM and 7 PM Masses on Tue Dec 8.

slots.rationale: Leaning per precedent st-isaac-jogues-wayne s27: the Holy Days line is the standing box, with no year or dated notice tying it to Dec 8 (unlike our-lady-of-consolation-parkesburg s12). The parish's current Seasonal Mass Times page lists December events but not Dec 8. Dec 8, 2026 is a Tuesday, so 6:30 and 8 AM are the weekly slots anyway. Hard because Dec 8 is a holy day of obligation and the times may well be right.
